jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You lead the commodity agenda for electrical insulation and copper materials for Large Generator products. From your base in Bucharest or Mülheim, you orchestrate the commodity circle, align closely with Engineering, Quality, and Operations, and turn market insight into resilient sourcing strategies and supplier agreements that secure capacity, reduce risk, and deliver measurable cost and sustainability impact. How You’ll Make an Impact* Developing and implementing the Commodity Strategy for Large Generator portfolio in alignment with Global Commodity Strategy for Electrical Insulation components e.g. Insulating Tapes (Mica, OCP, ICP etc.), Rigid Components like Prepreg, Rings, EPGx (sheets and machined profiles), Ropes, Tubes and Laminates. Additionally responsible for commodity management of Copper based material like Copper Flats, Insulated Flat Wires, Sheets, Profiles etc. in machined form. * Lead the Commodity Circle and drive the end to end strategic procurement cycle: market analysis & scouting, should cost insights, negotiation planning, eSourcing events, award proposals, and sourcing board preparations. * Secure capacity and supply resilience via frame contracts, price lists, and multi sourcing strategies; identify and mitigate risks (e.g., tariff exposure, single source, capacity constraints) and ensure continuity for critical Large Generator demand. * Deliver measurable value (CNI/savings, total cost improvements, inventory and cash objectives) and maintain transparent KPIs and spend dashboards for your area. * Drive early supplier involvement with Engineering and SQD to accelerate NPI/continuous improvement, quality robustness, and manufacturability—translating field and supply market feedback into actionable design-to-value measures. * Manage strategic supplier relationships: performance reviews, joint improvement roadmaps, and executive governance with top suppliers in EMEA and beyond. What You Bring* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Procurement, or Business—plus professional experience in direct material commodity management or category management in an industrial/manufacturing setting. * Familiarity with generator insulation systems and copper products (e.g., profiles, bars, wire, sheet) or adjacent electrical materials. Experience turning technical specs into sourcing strategies is key. * Supplier market analysis & scouting, cost modeling/should cost, competitive tendering, fact based negotiations, contracting (frame agreements/price lists), and risk management. * Proven ability to lead cross functional commodity teams (Commodity Circle) and influence at multiple levels, internally and at suppliers. * Proficiency with ERP/MRP and eSourcing platforms; comfort with KPI dashboards and data driven decisions. (Experience within Siemens Energy procurement frameworks is a plus.) * Professional fluency in English & German required for stakeholder and supplier interactions; Willingness to travel (~10–20%) for supplier visits and cross site collaboration.About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description: Job DescriptionPVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company with the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard. You will organize and manage administrative and commercial processes related to technical maintenance, servicing, and facility operations. This includes handling damages and insurance claims, monitoring maintenance and repair work, and coordinating activities with external service providers, landlords, and internal stakeholders, with a growing focus on sustainability and energy efficiency.A day in the life of an Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist:- Ensure EHS compliance across all retail stores and offices in the DACH region- Conduct regular store visits, audits, and risk assessments across sales floors, stockrooms, and back-of-house areas- Partner closely with Store Managers and Retail Operations to implement and maintain EHS standards in daily store operations- Support stores during peak trading periods, openings, refurbishments, and visual merchandising changes from a safety perspective- Investigate incidents (e.g. customer or employee accidents) and ensure timely follow-up and corrective actions- Provide hands-on EHS guidance and training tailored to retail teams- Coordinate maintenance, repairs, and safety-related topics with Facilities, landlords, and external service providers- Monitor fire safety, emergency procedures, and safe use of equipment in stores- Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with local regulations and internal policies- Support sustainability initiatives in stores, including waste management and energy efficiency- Collaborate with key stakeholders, including internal teams (Store Development, Expansion, Area Management, Store & Outlet Management, Procurement, Finance, Retail Operations, Sustainability) and external partners (service providers, contractors, suppliers, landlords, center managers)- Drive a proactive safety culture aligned with fast-paced retail environmentsWhat do we need from you? You have:- A degree or vocational training in Occupational Health & Safety, Facility Management, Business Administration or a related field- 2–4 years of experience in a similar role within facility management, technical services, or EHS; retail or multi-site experience is a plus- A hands-on, proactive mindset with strong organizational and coordination skills- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, retail-driven environment- Strong communication skills and confidence in working with diverse stakeholders- A structured and detail-oriented approach to documentation and reporting- A collaborative team spirit combined with the ability to work independently- Business fluent English and German (written and spoken)- Solid knowledge of EHS, facility management, or technical operations- Familiarity with retail safety standards and compliance requirements- Knowledge of ISO standards (e.g. ISO 14001, ISO 50001) is an advantage- Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)- Willingness to travel and a valid driving licenseWhat you can expect from us:- A smart working model (hybrid), including flex office solutions, a work from anywhere concept and meeting-free Fridays- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. Our PVH Leadership Behaviors empower everyone to lead — whether a team, a project or through individual expertise- A strong culture of development with extensive training and learning opportunities via our PVH University- A wide range of employee benefits, including employee discounts, mobility offers, internal sports classes and other initiativesOur employees come together from all areas of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender you are welcome here.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Sicherheitstechnik, Arbeitsplatzanalyse, Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung

jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionAs Senior Global Medical Manager Immuno-Oncology, you will contribute scientific and medical leadership to the global medical strategy for an early oncology brand. Reporting to the Brand Head Immuno-Oncology, you will be accountable for defined medical deliverables that prepare the asset and healthcare ecosystem for future clinical adoption and patient access. Working in a global matrix, including close collaboration with the Pipeline Medical Affairs Lead, you will translate scientific evidence, external insights and unmet needs into focused medical strategies, evidence-generation plans and measurable outcomes that help close relevant care gaps.Tasks & responsibilities- Contribute to the development and continuous refinement of the global medical strategy, translating strategic priorities, unmet needs and care gaps into clearly defined medical deliverables and outcome measures.- Take end-to-end accountability for the strategic direction, quality and timely delivery of major medical deliverables. These include Medical Affairs-led evidence generation, scientific communication and publications, external expert engagement, patient-journey and care-gap analysis, and medical launch preparation.- Shape and drive Medical Affairs-led evidence generation within the Integrated Evidence Plan, including investigator-initiated studies, Phase IIIb/IV studies, real-world evidence and other fit-for-purpose approaches that address decision-relevant evidence gaps and support future clinical practice.- Lead medical launch preparation for assigned areas by defining the scientific narrative, building organizational and country readiness, anticipating evidence and education needs, and supporting the conditions required for appropriate clinical adoption and patient access.- Build trusted scientific relationships with international experts, societies, research networks and other stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem, translating external insights into strategic recommendations, evidence priorities and medical action.- Provide medical leadership across global, regional and cross-functional teams, working closely with the Pipeline Medical Affairs Lead and partners in Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Commercial and country Medical Affairs to ensure strategic alignment and high-quality execution.Requirements- Advanced degree in medicine or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent) and long-term experience in Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry with global and regional/ local responsibility.- Mandatory, substantial experience in immuno-oncology and non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), supported by an in-depth understanding of the scientific and clinical landscape, evolving treatment paradigms, unmet needs and barriers across the patient journey. Experience in colorectal cancer (CRC), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and/or breast cancer is highly desirable.- Proven experience contributing to global medical strategy and leading complex medical workstreams for oncology assets, including medical launch preparation or indication expansion.- Demonstrated track record in shaping and delivering Medical Affairs-led evidence generation, including the identification and prioritization of evidence gaps, development of study concepts, oversight of study delivery and translation of results into decision-relevant medical insights.- Established collaboration with international oncology experts, scientific societies, research networks and other stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem, with the ability to convert external perspectives into strategic recommendations and action.- Strong matrix leadership, strategic judgment and execution discipline, with the ability to lead through influence, align diverse stakeholders and deliver high-quality outcomes in a complex global environment. Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills and full professional proficiency in English.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. behavior and business needs.As Product Owner for defined capabilities and processes within your assigned module, you will take end-to-end responsibility from business requirements and prioritization
